data.spec: Additive local workflow API in isolated NLS/office-workflows. GET /api/work -> {items:Work[]}; GET /api/work/templates -> {templates:[{key,title,description,steps:StepCreate[]}]}; POST /api/work WorkCreate -> Work; GET /api/work/:id -> Work; POST /api/work/:id/actions WorkAction -> Work; POST /api/work/:id/evidence EvidenceCreate -> Work; POST /api/work/:id/decisions WorkDecision -> Work. WorkCreate={event_key,title,outcome,owner='office-coordinator',template_key='custom',context:Record<string,string>,requester_id:null|string,priority:routine|urgent|critical,due_at:null|ISO,next_review_at:null|ISO,escalation_owner,simulation:boolean,steps?:StepCreate[]}. StepCreate={id,title,owner,depends_on:string[],required_evidence:string[],action_kind:human|local|purchase|message|booking|access,action_snapshot:object,requires_approval:boolean}. Work adds id,status:new|needs_information|ready|awaiting_approval|active|waiting|blocked|completed|cancelled|failed,version,waiting_reason,created_at,updated_at,evidence,history,links. Step adds status:pending|active|awaiting_approval|waiting|blocked|completed|failed|uncertain,approval:null|{fingerprint,status:pending|approved|rejected,expires_at,decided_by},execution:null|{id,status:started|confirmed|failed|uncertain,reference}. WorkAction={event_key,expected_version,action:assign|wait|block|resume|cancel|fail|start_step|complete_step|simulate_step|reconcile_step|close,step_id?,owner?,reason?,next_review_at?,reference?,result?:confirmed|failed|uncertain}. EvidenceCreate={event_key,expected_version,step_id,kind,summary,source,recorded_by}; WorkDecision={event_key,expected_version,step_id,approve,proposal_fingerprint}. Event keys bind exact request; stale versions conflict409. Existing purchases remain controlled by existing approval APIs; generic executor simulation-only. GET/POST /api/work/routines and GET /api/work/notifications added for restart-safe daily/weekly recurrence + local follow-up inbox; no outbound sends. SSE work.updated refreshes authoritative state. All DB-using routes async.
